title: feat(renk1): ridge-enter same-k holds at k=1: t=3 vs t=5
science: First display of ridge-enter kappa = rho3 + cost 3 on a 2->3 hop whose dest has exactly two unit coordinates; B_6, t(1,0,0)=3 vs t(1,1,1)=5, 27>25. Also records the forcing negative on the comparator eps (tax every 2->3): eps kills k=1 because (1,1,0)->(1,1,1) has three unit coordinates.
